Ava: Quick heads-up — pre-call with ClearNova at 11:30. They want to renew and add ~30% usage uplift. Asking whether we can convert expected overage into a pooled credit bucket for the 12-month renewal.
Miguel: Got it. Is their current commit annual or monthly?
Ava: Annual, 12mo term, 250k tokens/mo commit with a standard 10% renewal discount. They want effective 325k/mo but want predictable pricing (no surprise overage invoices).
Riley: From SE side: we can propose a tiered credit pool + burst band. Example: commit -> 300k tokens/mo reserved, pooled credits of 150k for spikes across quarter, overage rate reduced by 40% vs retail. That keeps predictability.
Priya: @Ava can you drop the current signed SOW and the last invoice? Deal Desk needs ARR number and the requested uplift to run a pricing exception. Anything >12% incremental discount needs VP approval.
Ava: Uploading SOW now. invoice + ARR in slack huddle — link: https://redwood.internal/invoices/ClearNova/2024-Q4
Ava: dealbot: uploaded invoice 2024_Q4.pdf
dealbot: invoice uploaded by Ava — 1 file attached
Sam (Legal): They'll also want contract language to cap overage billing and require notice 15 days before migrating tier. We should pre-author a clause: "Customer may apply unused pooled credits to subsequent month within same quarter."
Miguel: Important: does that clause affect revenue recognition? Finance check pls. If we allow carry-forward, might need to re-evaluate billing cadence.
Priya: Finance already flagged carry-forward as acceptable for credits within quarter. For multi-quarter carry, need CFO. For this ask (12mo, quarter carry), Deal Desk can approve commercial exception pending standard legal clause.
Ava: Proposed commercial terms to clear with customer on call: 12mo term, commit 300k tokens/mo, pooled quarterly credits = 450k (equivalent to 150k/mo spike capacity), overage billed at $0.0009/token (reduced), renewal discount 12% on list.
Riley: I'll include technical ops note: recommend enabling prefix caching + batch you to reduce steady-state token usage, saves them ~8-12% on expected usage. Helps justify lower overage rate.
Priya: I need the modeled ARR and margin impact to route to Deal Desk queue. @Miguel can you confirm target ACV and whether sales will accept a smaller commission uplift for this exception?
Miguel: ACV target $1.05M. Sales can take 50% of uplift commission to hit price. Approve routing.
Ava: On call now — will ask them to accept draft clause and confirm commit. Will ping with outcome. :thumbsup:
Ava: Post-call update: customer accepts tiered commit + pooled quarterly credits, wants final paperwork by EOD Friday.
Priya: Copy — I'll open a Deal Desk exception ticket and tag Legal for clause. Pulling ratecard override: CODE: DD-EXC-4621.
Sam (Legal): I'll draft the clause and sync with Priya. ETA EOD Thursday.
Miguel: Great — once legal signs off we can send amendment and get e-sign. Thanks team. :rocket:
